Red-bordered white box containing the formula f(x)=(x-5)^2+1 in black text.

Cartesian plot of f(x)=(x-5)^2+1. Grid is light gray. Axes are black with tick labels -5, 0, 5, 10, 15 on both x and y. Blue parabola has minimum at (5,1), labeled (5,1), with a green point. A red point marks (3,9); a black horizontal segment runs from (3,9) to (7,9), and (7,9) is labeled. Red dashed lines mark x=5 and the minimum level.
White annotation box with red border containing two lines: X is in between 4.8 and color red bold 5.1; f(x) is in between 1.04 and 1.01.
Red arrow points down/right toward the first columns of the main table.
Purple arrow associated with the purple Bouncing label points down/right toward the oscillating 4.8/5.1 columns of the main table.

recreation_brief: 1. Use a blank white slide. 2. Add a title text box at the top left reading 'Convex Function,  Learning Rate =0.3, Start at X=3'; make 'Convex Function,' red bold, 'Learning Rate =0.3,' green bold, and 'Start at X=3' blue bold. 3. Add a yellow circle at the top right containing '31'. 4. Add a 3-row, 2-column parameter table at the top left: step | 0.3; initial X | 3; delta | 0.1; use yellow label cells and white value cells. 5. Add a red-bordered white box at the top center containing 'f(x)=(x-5)^2+1'. 6. Add a graph at the top right with white background, light gray grid, black axes labeled x and y with ticks -5, 0, 5, 10, 15; draw the blue parabola f(x)=(x-5)^2+1; mark (5,1) with a green point and label it; mark (3,9) with a red point; draw a black horizontal segment from (3,9) to (7,9) and label (7,9); add red dashed lines at x=5 and y=1. 7. Add a red-bordered white annotation box below the formula with the two lines 'X is in between 4.8 and color red bold 5.1' and 'f(x) is in between 1.04 and 1.01'. 8. Add the purple word 'Bouncing' above the table with a purple arrow pointing to the oscillating columns. 9. Add a red arrow pointing to the first columns of the table. 10. Insert a 9-row by 17-column table across the bottom: first column labels are x, f(x), x-delta, f(x-delta), x+delta, f(x+delta), slope, next x; fill the 16 data columns exactly with the values listed in the main table visual element. Use yellow for the x row, light green for f(x), f(x-delta), and f(x+delta), light blue for x-delta and x+delta, gray for slope, and light orange for next x.
